name: LINE group member claim auto-onboarding
type: HOZO claims identity and source authorization
requiresDatabases: Existing AM claims authority PostgreSQL database
requiresEnv: Existing claims authority identity key and Finance Claims V3 machine bridge configuration

dataIsolation.guard: AM keeps raw LINE targets encrypted and exposes only tenant-scoped opaque references; Rental receives the raw subject transiently through the authenticated bridge.

definitionOfDone: An observed member of an active published claims group is eligible unless manually denied
First use can create a claim-only external Finance identity without an admin account
External identities do not gain employee reimbursement or administration capabilities
Applicant notification routing survives runtime restart through the encrypted authority registry
Legacy forms, V3, named templates, idempotency and individual denial remain compatible
